description: This Java class models the outcome of processing an inbound external message, including possible mapping results, errors, and the actor handle involved.

classes.name: InboundMappingOutcomes
classes.description: Encapsulates the results of mapping an inbound external message, including outcomes, potential errors, and the sender actor.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an InboundMappingOutcomes instance representing an error condition with the specified message, error, and sender.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an InboundMappingOutcomes instance with specified outcomes, external message, and sender.

methods.name: getOutcomes
methods.description: Returns the list of mapping outcomes.

methods.name: getExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns the external message associated with these outcomes.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error encountered during processing, if any.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Indicates whether the processing resulted in an error.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the actor reference representing the sender of the message.
